# Comment inventory and removal rules

Task **T175** (inventory for T176–T181). Snapshot: commit `179f3a4`,
2026-11-01, clean working tree before this report.

Scope: the first-party source tree — `engine/src/`, `ui/src/`, `tests/`,
`scripts/` and the first-party build/config files. `third_party/`,
`build*/`, `ui/dist*`, `ui/node_modules/`, `docs/` and `plan/` are exempt.
No source file was modified for this task.

Method: a tokenizer counted comment tokens and physical lines while skipping
C/C++ strings and raw strings, JS/TS template literals, regex literals and
JSX text, shell quotes/heredocs, CMake bracket strings and YAML block
scalars. A **comment token** is one `//`, `/* … */`, `# …`, `#!…` or
`<!-- … -->` comment. A **comment line** is a physical line that intersects
a comment; every line inside a multi-line block comment counts once.
Standalone means the line contains only comment text; trailing means code
remains on the line. Numbers below are exact at the snapshot commit. File
counts are files actually scanned for comments; generated, binary and empty
placeholder files are listed separately or omitted.

## 3. Directive patterns that must survive

The only directives currently present in first-party source are the five
shell shebangs and the generated-file header. Every other row is a
**keep-if-added** rule: if such a comment exists at cleanup time, keep it
verbatim and keep its explanation with it.

| Directive pattern | Form / canonical example | Current occurrences | Rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shebang | `#!/usr/bin/env bash`, `#!/bin/sh` | 5 shell files, plus 1 embedded in `release.yml` block scalar | Always line 1 of a shell file (or first line of the embedded script); keep byte-for-byte, keep the file executable. |
| Generated marker | `This file was auto-generated by …`, `@generated`, `DO NOT EDIT`, `Code generated …` | 1 file: `ui/src/api/schema.d.ts:1-4` | Never edit a generated file; marker and the whole header stay. |
| clang-tidy suppression | `// NOLINT`, `// NOLINTNEXTLINE(...)`, `// NOLINTBEGIN`, `// NOLINTEND` | 0 | Keep the whole comment, including the rule name and reason. |
| clang-format control | `// clang-format off` / `// clang-format on` | 0 | Keep both markers; do not reformat the guarded region. |
| ESLint control | `// eslint-disable`, `// eslint-disable-next-line`, `// eslint-disable-line`, `/* eslint-disable … */`, `// eslint-enable` | 0 | Keep the whole comment, including rule lists and `-- reason`. |
| TypeScript suppression | `// @ts-expect-error`, `// @ts-ignore`, `// @ts-nocheck`, `// @ts-check` | 0 | Keep; `@ts-expect-error` must stay immediately above the offending line. |
| Prettier control | `// prettier-ignore`, `// prettier-ignore-start`, `// prettier-ignore-end` | 0 | Keep; the target node/region must not be reformatted. |
| Python lint suppression | `# noqa`, `# noqa: E501` | 0 in scope (no Python here; `plan/autopilot.py` is exempt) | Keep if Python enters scope. |
| Source map | `//# sourceMappingURL=…` | 0 in first-party source | Keep in generated/bundled output; never add or strip by hand. |
| Bundler annotations | `/* @vite-ignore */`, `/* @__PURE__ */`, `/* @__NO_SIDE_EFFECTS__ */` | 0 | Keep; they are consumed by Vite/Rollup/esbuild. |
| Shell lint suppression | `# shellcheck disable=SC…`, `# shellcheck shell=bash` | 0 | Keep the whole comment. |
| CMake formatter control | `# cmake-format: off` / `# cmake-format: on` | 0 | Keep. |
| TypeScript triple-slash | `/// <reference types="…" />` | 0 | Keep at the top of the file. |
| Test environment | `// @vitest-environment jsdom`, `// @jest-environment node` | 0 | Keep; it changes the test runtime. |
| ESLint environment/globals | `/* eslint-env node */`, `/* global … */` | 0 | Keep. |
| Coverage suppression | `/* istanbul ignore … */`, `/* c8 ignore … */`, `# pragma: no cover` | 0 | Keep. |
| Static-analysis suppression | `// cppcheck-suppress …`, `// IWYU pragma: …`, `// codeql[…]` | 0 | Keep. |

Tool-consumed directives are recognised from the comment body after the
`//`, `/*`, `*` or `#` delimiter. A string or prose mention is not a
directive. `#pragma once`, `#include`, `#define`, `[[fallthrough]]` and
`[[nodiscard]]` are code directives, not comments; they must never be
removed.

## 4. Risky cases found in this tree

These are the places a naive grep/sed pass will corrupt code. All counts and
line numbers are from the snapshot commit.

| Risk | Evidence | Handling |
|---|---|---|
| `//` inside URL strings | 28 code lines: 3 C++ (`engine/src/app/ControlApi.cpp:141`, `engine/src/api/Pairing.cpp:264`, `engine/src/Bridge/WebView.cpp:105`), 7 tests (`tests/ui/screenshot.cpp:135`, `tests/api/core_api/Meters.cpp:15`, `tests/api/session_api/Meters.cpp:17`, `tests/api/session_api/PatchMix.cpp:46`, `tests/api/pairing/Pairing.cpp:35`, `tests/api/state_broadcast/Fixtures.h:31`, `tests/app/serve-smoke.sh:62`), 14 TS/TSX (e.g. `ui/src/main.tsx:25`, `ui/src/testing/fixtures/pairing.ts:25`, `ui/src/testing/scenarios/pairing.tsx:33,120`), 4 shell (`scripts/dev.sh:87,99,100,104`) | Never scan raw text with a `//` regex. Tokenize strings, template literals and raw strings first. |
| `//` inside comment prose and JSDoc examples | `engine/src/api/Pairing.h:33`, `ui/src/api/client.ts:57`, `ui/src/features/grid/MeterStore.ts:12`, `ui/src/features/grid/meterTransport.ts:5`, and the comment at `ui/src/testing/scenarios/pairing.tsx:19-27` | Deleting the whole comment is safe; do not split a URL or leave a truncated `*` line. |
| Regex literals with slashes | `ui/src/api/client.ts:139` `/\/+$/`, `ui/src/features/plugins/model.ts:95` `/\s+/`, `ui/src/features/pairing/model.ts:76` `/\D/g`, `ui/src/features/remote/model.ts:120` `/\/remote\/?$/` | Treat a regex literal as opaque; `/\D/g` and `/\/remote\/?$/` are not comments. |
| JSX closing tags | Every `.tsx` file; `</div>`, `</section>`, `</button>` | `</` is a tag close, never a comment. A parser that treats `/` after `<` as a regex start will swallow markup (this happened in the first inventory pass). |
| CSS `#` colours and universal selector | 484 hex colours in `ui/src/*.css`; e.g. `ui/src/styles.css:6` `#101014`; `ui/src/styles.css:9` `* {` | CSS has only `/* … */` comments. Never strip `#` from CSS; `* {` is a selector, not a block-comment line. |
| C++ raw string literals | 93 raw strings in 23 files; route regexes such as `engine/src/api/routes/FxRoutes.cpp:266` `R"(/patches/(\d+)/fx)"`; YAML fixture `tests/controller/mapping/Fixtures.cpp:46` `R"(# generated by ihub-mapping-test …` | Skip from `R"delim(` to `)delim"`. The `#` inside the fixture raw string is data, not a comment. |
| Lines beginning with `*` that are code | 26 dereference lines, e.g. `engine/src/audio/device/DeviceOpen.cpp:51` `*errorMessage = …`; `tests/api/AudioMeasurements.cpp:99` `* blockSize;` | Do not treat a leading `*` as block-comment continuation outside a known block-comment span. |
| C++ preprocessor `#` | 3,945 preprocessor lines (`#include`, `#pragma once`, `#define`, `#if`) | C++ comments are only `//` and `/* … */`; never use a `#` stripper on C++. |
| Shell heredoc and quoted `#` | `scripts/bootstrap.sh:188` `cat <<'EOF'`; `#` text inside the heredoc at lines 192 and 201; `#` inside quoted `echo` at lines 232–233 | Strip `#` only when the shell grammar says a comment starts. Skip heredoc bodies and quoted strings. |
| YAML block scalars | 11 `#` lines inside `run: |` bodies in `.github/workflows/release.yml` (100, 158–163, 189, 516–517, 521), including `#!/bin/sh` at 158 | These are shell content, not YAML comments. A YAML comment stripper must skip block-scalar bodies. |
| Generated source | `ui/src/api/schema.d.ts` 571 comment lines / 269 tokens, header lines 1–4 | Exempt. Regenerated by `pnpm build`; edits are lost and would change generated API docs. |
| Generated snapshots | `tests/artifacts/*.html` (15 files), `*.png` (6 files) | Exempt and gitignored; do not edit. |
| Binary fixtures | `tests/project/fixtures/set-v1.ihub`; `shared/set.plugin-state/*.bin` | Never open as text or apply comment rules. |
| JSON files | `CMakePresets.json`, `ui/tsconfig.json`, `ui/package.json` | Strict JSON: no comments to remove and no `//` stripping. Descriptions are data. |
| Block-comment nesting | 0 block comments contain a nested `/*` or `*/` in this tree | Still delete the whole `/* … */` token; do not use a regex that stops at an inner marker. |
| Trailing alignment comments | `} // namespace …` (495 engine + many tests); `ui/src/features/pairing/qr.ts:113,114,238,263` aligned comments; one-line JSDoc followed by code at `ui/src/features/remote/model.ts:123` | Remove code-trailing comments and their preceding padding; leave no trailing whitespace and do not reflow the code. |

## 5. Removal rules

R1. **Directive first.** If a comment matches any row in §3, keep the whole
comment verbatim (delimiters, rule list, reason, line position). When unsure,
keep it and record the decision.

R2. **Delete the whole token.** Remove `// …` to end of line, `/* … */`
including every interior line, `# …` to end of line, and `<!-- … -->`
including every interior line. Never remove only the opening/closing
delimiters. For a block comment that shares a line with code, replace the
comment with a single space if needed to keep tokens separate; otherwise
just delete it.

R3. **Never touch literals.** C/C++ strings, character literals and raw
strings (`R"delim(…)delim"`), JS/TS strings, template literals, regex
literals and JSX text, CSS strings and `url(...)`, shell quoted strings and
heredoc bodies, YAML quoted values and block-scalar bodies, and JSON string
values are opaque. This is the rule that prevents the §4 corruption.

R4. **Never touch code directives.** `#pragma`, `#include`, `#define`,
`#if`, `[[attribute]]`, shebang lines and generated-file markers are not
ordinary comments.

R5. **Line cleanup.** If deleting a comment leaves a line empty or
whitespace-only, delete that line. Strip trailing whitespace left by a
trailing comment. Do not reflow code, reorder includes, change indentation,
or reformat unrelated lines. Leave neighbouring blank lines alone unless a
run consists only of deleted comment lines; collapsing such a run to one
blank line is allowed.

R6. **Generated files are read-only.** Do not edit
`ui/src/api/schema.d.ts`, `tests/artifacts/*`, `ui/dist*`, `build*`, or any
file whose header says it is generated. Regenerate instead.

R7. **Binaries are read-only.** Never scan or rewrite `.ihub`, `.bin`,
`.png`, `.wav`, `.so`, `.a`, `.o` or other binary artefacts.

R8. **JSON has no comments.** Do not add comment syntax to
`CMakePresets.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `package.json` or schema JSON.

R9. **Language-specific comment syntax.**
- C/C++: `//` and `/* … */` only; preprocessor `#` is not a comment.
- TS/TSX: `//`, `/* … */`, JSDoc `/** … */`; `{/* … */}` would be a JSX
  comment and must be removed as a whole expression, but none exist here.
- CSS: `/* … */` only; `#` is a colour/id, `//` is not a comment.
- Shell: `#` at a comment-start position only; keep `#!` and skip quotes,
  heredocs and `${var#…}` parameter expansion.
- CMake: `#` only, including bracket comments `#[[ … ]]`; skip bracket
  strings and quoted arguments.
- YAML: `#` outside quotes and outside `|`/`>` block scalars; block-scalar
  `#` lines are content.
- HTML: `<!-- … -->` only; do not strip URLs or `//` in text.

R10. **Shebangs stay.** The five existing shebangs remain line 1 with
unchanged text and executable bits. Keep the embedded AppImage shebang in
`release.yml` block-scalar content.

R11. **Verify the diff.** After each cleanup task, inspect `git diff` (or
`git diff --word-diff`) for changed string literals, URLs, regexes, CSS
colours and indentation. A diff that changes anything other than comment
tokens/blank lines is wrong.

R12. **Run the task's acceptance check.** `pnpm typecheck` and
`pnpm test:snapshot` for `ui/src/`; `scripts/test.sh` for engine/tests;
build-file changes must still configure and build. Do not run the suite after
every edit — once when the task is finished.

## 6. Work map for T176–T181

This partition covers all 9,958 comment lines exactly once.

| Task | Paths | Comment lines | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---|
| T176 | `ui/src/` | 1,332 | 720 features, 335 state, 137 testing, 122 api, 18 root; 570 JSDoc, 154 `//`, 5 CSS. Exclude `schema.d.ts` (571 more, generated). |
| T177 | `engine/src/api/`, `session/`, `project/` | 1,588 | 947 + 411 + 230. |
| T178 | `engine/src/audio/`, `dsp/`, `instruments/`, `sampler/` | 2,956 | 1,747 + 427 + 263 + 519. Preserve the audio-thread contract. |
| T179 | Rest of `engine/src/` | 1,951 | `controller/` 458, `plugins/` 736, `app/` 272, `Bridge/` 24, `diag/` 134, root 327. |
| T180 | `tests/`, `scripts/`, root/engine CMake | 2,049 | 1,923 tests + 65 scripts + 8 + 53. Keeps 5 shebangs. `tests/` includes both CMake files. |
| T181 | Whole tree + remaining build/config | 82 | 13 `ui/vite*.ts` + 69 workflow comments, plus any survivors; record final counts and exemptions here. |

T176–T179 have no directives at all, so their target is zero comments.
T180 leaves the five shebangs. T181 should leave only those shebangs and the
exempt generated/schema group, unless a directive is introduced meanwhile.

The out-of-scope `.gitignore` (8 comment lines) and `shared/set.yaml` (36)
are not in the 9,958 total. T181 should either record them as exemptions or
handle them explicitly if the human widens the tree; do not silently strip
them under T176–T180.

## 7. Reproduction and acceptance

Directive audit used for §3 (returns nothing in first-party scope at this
commit; `schema.d.ts` is generated):

```sh
grep -RInE 'NOLINT|clang-format[[:space:]]+(off|on)|eslint-(disable|enable)|@ts-(expect-error|ignore|nocheck|check)|prettier-ignore|noqa|istanbul ignore|c8 ignore|type:[[:space:]]*ignore|pragma:[[:space:]]*no cover|cppcheck-suppress|IWYU pragma|codeql\[|@vitest-environment|@jest-environment|///[[:space:]]*<reference|sourceMappingURL|shellcheck|cmake-format|vite-ignore|__PURE__' \
  engine/src ui/src tests scripts CMakeLists.txt engine/CMakeLists.txt tests/CMakeLists.txt tests/plugins/CMakeLists.txt \
  ui/vite.config.ts ui/vite.snapshot.config.ts .github/workflows
```

Shebang audit:

```sh
grep -RIn '^#!' scripts tests/app .github/workflows
```

Counts in this report come from the tokenizer described at the top; `grep`
spot checks agree with it at the snapshot: CMake has exactly 8 + 53 + 443 +
60 `#` comment lines, and raw `/*` occurrences equal block-comment tokens
(1,271 engine, 45 tests). Raw `//` counts exceed line-comment tokens only by
the URL/string cases listed in §4.

Acceptance for T175 is that this file exists, covers every area above, lists
the directive rules and risky cases, and that **no source file changed**.
At hand-off the only working-tree difference must be this untracked report
(and the autopilot result file), verified with:

```sh
git status --porcelain          # only ?? plan/COMMENTS.md
git diff --name-only            # empty
```
